senses.gloss: वि—ष्टाव m. (fr. वि + स्ताव) a subdivision of the periods of a Stoma, Lāṭy.
1. विष्ट॑ mfn. (for 2. See under √ विष्) entered into, contained in (acc. or loc.), ŚBr.; BhP.
filled or accompanied with (instr.), TS.
2. विष्ट mfn. (for 1. See p. 989, col. 2) only in परि- and सं-व्˚, q.v.
1. 2. विष्ट . See under √ विश् and √ 1. विष्.
विष्टा f. the feces, excrement (w.r. for विष्ठा).
विष्ट—कर्ण mfn. marked on the ear in a partic. manner, Pāṇ. vi, 3, 115
विष्ट—त्व n. the being connected or accompanied with, Nyāyas., Sch.
विष्ट—पुर m. N. of a man g. शुभ्रादि.
1. विष्टि f. (for 2. See p. 999, col. 1) service, (esp.) forced s˚, compulsory work, drudgery (also collectively ‘servants, slaves, bondsmen’), MBh.; R.; Inscr. (ifc. also ˚टिक)
विष्टि m. N. of one of the seven Ṛṣis in the 11th Manv-antara, MārkP.
2. विष्टि f. (for 1. See p. 996, col. 2) = वृष्टि, rain, L.
विष्˚टी॑ or विष्˚टि॑भिस्, ind. changing, alternatively, by turns, RV. (in this sense accord. to some from वि + √ 1. अस्; cf. अभि-, परि-ष्टि).
विष्˚टी॑ or विष्˚टि॑भिस्, ind. changing, alternatively, by turns, RV. (in this sense accord. to some from वि + √ 1. अस्; cf. अभि-, परि-ष्टि).
विष्टि—कर m. the lord of bondsmen or slaves, MBh. (Nīlak.)
= next, VarBṛS.
विष्टि—कृत् m. a servant, slave, bondsman, ib.
वि-ष्टीमिन् mfn. (√ स्तीम्) making or becoming wet,VS.
विष्ट् See √ वेष्ट्.
वि-ष्टन् w.r. for वि-√ स्तन्, q.v.
वि-ष्ट॑प् f. top, summit, surface, highest part, height (esp. of heaven), RV.; VS.; PañcavBr.; ĀśvŚr.
वि-˚ष्ट॑प n. (rarely m.) id., RV.; VS.; Br. (with ऋषभस्य, ‘a hump’, ŚBr.; ˚पे ind. in heaven, Āpast.)
forking or bifurcation (of an Udumbara branch), VS., Sch.
a world, Mn.; MBh. &c.
वि-˚ष्ट॑पे ind., in heaven, Āpast.
वि-˚ष्टप—त्रय n. the three worlds (cf. लोक-त्र्˚), Ragh.
वि-˚ष्टप—हारिन् mfn. world-ravishing, Bhartṛ.
वि॑-ष्टब्ध mfn. firmly set or bound, ŚBr.; Mn.; MBh.
rigid, stiff, MBh.; Hariv.; Suśr.
checked, stopped, restrained, arrested, obstructed, paralysed, MBh.; R.; Suśr.
propped, supported, MBh.; Suśr.
filled, stuffed, PañcavBr.
undigested, Suśr.
वि-ष्टब्ध—गात्र mfn. with rigid limbs, Hariv.
वि-ष्टब्ध—चरण mfn. with r˚ feet, MBh.
वि-ष्टब्ध—ता f. firmness, confidence, MW.
वि-ष्टब्˚धाक्ष mfn. with r˚ eyes, Suśr.
वि-ष्टब्˚धाजीर्ण n. indigestion arising from obstruction, ib.
वि-˚ष्टब्धि f. fixing firmly, propping, supporting, Anup.
वि-ष्टभ m. ‘fixed or planted firmly’, the world, W.
वि॑-˚ष्टभित (वि॑-), mfn. fixed firmly, well founded, AV.
वि-ष्टम्भ॑ m. fixing, planting firmly (पद-व्˚), Kir.
prop, support, RV.; AV.; MBh.; Śaṃk.
‘supporters’, N. of partic. syllables inserted in sacred texts, PañcavBr.
checking, stopping, restraint, impediment, suppression, Kām.; BhP.
endurance, resistance, MBh.
obstruction of the urine or feces, ischury, constipation, Suśr.
a partic. disease of the fetus, ŚārṅgS.
paralysis, loss of motion, W.
वि-ष्टम्भ—कर mfn. stopping, restraining, obstructing, Suśr.
वि-˚ष्टम्भन mf(ई)n. propping, supporting, VS.
वि-˚ष्टम्भन n. checking, restraining, suppressing, MaitrUp.
वि-˚ष्टम्भयिषु mfn. wishing to stop or cause to stand still (a fleeing army), MBh. vii, 1746 (B. संस्तम्भयिषु).
वि-˚ष्टम्भित mfn. fixed firmly &c.
entirely filled or covered with (instr.), Hariv.
वि-˚ष्टम्भिन् mfn. supporting (lit. and fig.), Hcat.
checking, stopping, obstructing, Suśr.
chilling, W.
making motionless, ib.
वि-ष्टर m. (√ स्तृ) anything spread out, a handful of rushes or grass for sitting on (esp. the seat of the presiding Brāhman at a sacrifice), GṛŚrS.; MBh.
a seat made of 25 shoots of Kuśa grass tied up in a sheaf, W.
a tree, L.
N. of a divine being reckoned among the Viśve Devāḥ, Hariv.
वि-ष्टर m. n. any seat or couch, chair, stool &c., MBh.; Kāv. &c.
वि-ष्टर mfn. = वि-स्तर, extensive, wide (?) See comp.
वि-ष्टार॑ m. a layer of grass (?), RV. v, 52, 10 (others ‘the far spread host, scil. of the Maruts’)
a kind of metre (cf. next and Pāṇ. iii, 3, 34; viii, 3, 94)
वि-ष्टर—भाज् mfn. occupying a seat, seated, Ragh.
वि-ष्टर—श्रव m. = next, Hcat.
वि-ष्टर—श्रवस् m. ‘broad-eared’ or ‘far-famed’, N. of Viṣṇu-Kṛṣṇa, MBh.; Hariv.; Śiś.
of Śiva, Śivag.
वि-ष्टर—स्थ mfn. sitting on a seat, reclining on a bed (of leaves &c.), W.
वि-ष्ट˚राश्व m. N. of a son of Pṛthu, Hariv.
वि-ष्ट˚रोत्तर mfn. covered with Kuśa grass, MW.
वि-ष्टार॑—पङ्क्ति (˚टार॑-), f. a partic. form of Paṅkti metre (consisting of 8 × 12 × 12 × 8 syllables), VS.; RPrāt.
वि-ष्टार—बृहती f. a species of Bṛhatī (8 × 10 × 10 × 8 syllables), RPrāt.
वि-˚ष्टारिन् mfn. (prob.) spread, extended (applied to a partic. oblation), AV.
वि-ष्टि॑र् f. expansion (opp. to सं-स्तिर्), RV.
वि-ष्टु (√ स्तु) P. -ष्टौति, or -ष्टवीति (impf. व्य्-अस्तौत् or व्य्-अष्टौत्, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 70), to praise very much, extol with praises, MBh.
वि॑-ष्टुत mfn. praised highly, extolled, TBr.
वि॑-ष्टुति f. a variety of arrangement for reciting the verses of the Tri-vṛt Stoma (3 such varieties are enumerated, viz. उद्यती, परिवर्तिनी, and कुलायिनी), Br.; Lāṭy.
pl. N. of a treatise on Vedic ritual.
वि-ष्टुभ् (√ स्तुभ्) Ā. -ष्टोभते (aor. व्य्-अष्टोभिष्ट), Vop.
